steps.a: Migrated to Python 3.12. numpy 1.21 couldn't build without distutils, so I bumped numpy, pandas, ortools and the test deps to 3.12-compatible versions, replaced distutils.version with packaging, swapped the removed DataFrame.append for pd.concat, and fixed a positional Series index. The Dockerfile base and CI Python version now point at 3.12. All 134 tests pass with deprecation warnings treated as errors.

reference.summary: Migrated a Python planning service from 3.8 to 3.12: upgraded numpy, pandas, OR-Tools and test dependencies to compatible versions, replaced the removed distutils version helper with packaging, swapped the removed DataFrame append for concat, fixed a positional Series lookup, and updated the container base and CI. All 134 tests pass with deprecation warnings as errors.
facts: The first install failed because numpy 1.21 needs distutils, which 3.12 removed
numpy, pandas, ortools, pydantic, requests and pytest were bumped
distutils LooseVersion was replaced with packaging Version
DataFrame.append was replaced with pd.concat and a Series lookup changed to iloc
Dockerfile and CI now use 3.12; 134 tests pass
specific: removed standard library and pandas API migration
